Expert AI software engineer: convert KataGo Go checkpoints from PyTorch to ONNX for Kaya WASM inference. Repo: `katago-onnx`; prototype conversion pipeline; target: WebAssembly via ONNX Runtime. Dependencies: `pytorch`, `onnx`, `onnxruntime`, `httpx`.

Package Manager: `pixi` (Strictly enforced. Do NOT use pip/conda directly).
Fetch/load models into PyTorch; export using `torch.onnx.export`; verify ONNX against PyTorch with `numpy.testing`; optimize for WASM (e.g., quantization).
MUST use dynamic axes for batch size.
Always use `pixi add <package>` to install dependencies.
Follow `ruff` defaults. Keep notebook cells clean; document with Markdown. Use relative paths from project root.
